name: ad-lockout-list
description:
R158.49.1 (2026-10-07) supersedes R158.49 callerComputerName regex. R158.49 used `[^
\-]+` excluding '-' thinking EN message may have trailing '-' terminator. But workstation hostnames routinely contain '-' (DL-08001-D, KDLFL-OFADSRV1, SRV-DC01-PROD). The '-' exclusion caused greedy match to stop at first '-', shipping 'DL' for 'DL-08001-D' -> operator reported wrong CallerComputerName in /locked-accounts view. Fix: collect up to EOL (`\s*$`) using non-greedy `.+?\s*$` with multiline mode (?ms). R158.50.6 stdout error field preserved + R158.50.5 FilterXml preserved.
